viewing_check: Estimate $20-30, current bid $10. At viewing: (1) Open both Hawthorn books and look for any signature, inscription, or loose signed item; check the Challenge Me the Race verso for 1958 with no later impression. (2) Count the Churchill volumes, confirm all four, check each verso for 'First published' with no impression line. (3) Note the years of all Royal Academy Pictures volumes. (4) Read the middle-row cycling items and the red bull-cover book. Without a signature this is a A$80-150 lot; worth bidding to about A$60-80 all in.
